.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Fusion Rate] 0% 
Operator shows no signs of infection at this time.

[Blood Crystal Density] 0.09u/L 
Physical data reveal this Operator to be in a roughly healthy state.

[Cardigan]
Cardigan is a proactive and confident Operator who carries out both daily tasks and combat missions with vigor. As a member of Reserve Op Team A4, Cardigan is very fond of all her teammates.

[Cardigan's History 1]
Cardigan was born the oldest of five children in the frigid northern region of Leithanien to a mother and father who worked in the forests. Growing up in a comfortable and relaxed household, she had harmonious and intimate relationships with all her family members. When she was a child, she dreamed of becoming a professional skier. With her family's support, she took a shot at her dream, but ultimately failed to succeed. She quit ski training and was recruited by a bobsled patrol team. It was during this time that Cardigan underwent defensive and tactical training.

[Cardigan's History 2]
Before she was recruited by Rhodes Island, she left her hometown, curious about city life. She made her way to the center of Leithanien to seek work, but due to its focus on Arts and her lack of talent for it, as well as her love of sport, she felt the city wasn't a good fit for her. During her stay in Leithanien, she met fellow travelers Steward and Adnachiel and formed a deep friendship with them. Even after the two of them became infected, Cardigan continued to put all her effort into helping her friends make it through, and contacted Rhodes Island to seek treatment for them.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hello! It's my shift now, Doctor!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: What does my 'Cardigan' codename mean? Ahh, It's actually the name of my clan. It's a family tradition to use it as a codename.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Wow, I found one of my people on another team! I've got to invite her to hang out with me sometime!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I was born in the north of Leithanien, a place full of snowy forests. Oh, that reminds me, I can teach you to ski, Doctor!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: A lot of people say stuff like 'it's a Defender's job to hold her ground,' but that's such an outdated concept. Speed is what you need! This is the age of maneuver warfare! Mobility is the key to victory!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: *Sniff sniff*... I recognize that perfume, it's gotta be Melantha! I hope we can become closer friends... 'Cause then we'll be able to work better as a team!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Hehe, I really enjoy playing with kids. Back in my hometown, I took my brothers and sisters sledding every year. I really miss it! Oh, speaking of sleds... I wonder if Adnachiel can make one for me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I have plenty of things I don't like. Oripathy, for instance... But there's no point in worrying too much. I would rather live my days in happiness! Plus, I've got you with me, Doctor!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Woof!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Heeellooo! I've never been in such a big mobile facility before! I'm so excited! Merry of the Cardigan here. Are you the Doctor?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Ehehe, thanks!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Yay! I will keep fighting hard for my next promotion! I'm sure it will come in time!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Awesome! Finally, my time has come!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Ansel! Come on! I promise I won't lead everyone on a wild-goose chase!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Formation ready! Advance to the objective!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let's go! ...Steward, what was I supposed to do next?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: There's no hesitating in battle!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: All right!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Understood!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I will protect us all!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Aha!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Your attacks have no effect!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I knew we could do it. Right, Adnachiel?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Yeeaaah! A flawless victory!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Thanks, Medics! You saved my life...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ughh... Sorry, Ansel...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Steward, what should I do next?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Woah! Roller coaster—!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Melantha? Huh? Why are you here, Doctor?!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! I wonder why there's no snow outside. And after I spent all that time getting my sled ready… When will I ever get to rocket down the slopes straight into a snowdrift like I did when I was little?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I'm right here, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Yay! Happy birthday, Doctor! Hm, something smells good. You got a gift from Melantha, didn't you? What a scent! Melantha taught me how to make perfume, actually, do you want to try with me?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I promise I'll be more careful, I won't break anything! Sorry… Honestly, my salary won't even be enough to cover the damages if I keep breaking things… heheh…
